head: 278a67f037834ef793b88b8cbdd8019061743a8a
scope: Generic Core lifecycle for all active tenants with enabled plugin auth.credentials and active, explicitly opted-in business permissions; no tenant or AI Craft special case.
changes: Normal startup and central MigrateCoreModels initialize missing tracking and initial member snapshots under the existing source transaction lock.
Subsequent official tenant, plugin configuration and permission source transactions discover missing registrations before commit.
Existing starts, receipts and unchanged decisions/revisions are preserved; no role grants are created.
Startup initializes newly discovered tracks only; offline source drift is not rewritten as new grant/revoke history.
Queries, CLI precheck and recovery verify/hold/coordinator-maintenance startup remain read-only.
Legacy controlled apply can reuse a Core-owned receipt without changing it; manual legacy receipt conflict rules remain.
Typed capability, Framework response schema and plugin business activation are unchanged.
Migration payload hashing now includes the authorization dependencies called by core migrations.

validation.environment: POWERX_BASELINE_POSTGRES_DSN and POWERX_BASELINE_MIGRATION_TEST_DSN pointed only to an agent-owned PostgreSQL 14 instance at 127.0.0.1:59317
validation.result: passed; five tested packages; tenant has no test files

validation.environment: separate initially empty powerx_baseline_migration_test_20261019_final database on the same temporary instance
validation.result: passed; production connection factory, fresh full migration, old multi-tenant data, repeated full migration, later tenant/plugin enable
passed; compiled only, did not start the app

regressions: Multiple tenants and multiple unrelated plugins; opt-in, inactive and technical permission filters.
Existing manual start, receipt, epoch, decisions and fact revisions preserved across repeated initialization.
Initial allow is initialized with null granted_at; initial deny stays denied; later actual grant is native.
New tenant/plugin/permission registration in both orders; previously inactive tenant/plugin activation.
Initialization and role membership concurrency in both PostgreSQL commit orders.
Rollback of source mutation and newly created ledger rows on initialization/decision persistence failure.
Read-only precheck and typed service reads; startup skips recovery read-only and maintenance modes.
Partial schema rejection, existing blocked status preservation, external source drift remains unavailable.
Initialization inside an existing source transaction preserves its commit reconciliation.

development_failures.failure: Fresh production-factory migration hit PostgreSQL cached plan must not change result type after schema expansion.
development_failures.resolution: Discovery now selects only required permission columns rather than SELECT *; final fresh migration race test passed.

development_failures.failure: An existing minimal member-service test fixture omitted the permission catalog now required by discovery.
development_failures.resolution: Added the empty Permission table to that isolated fixture; production fail-closed behavior was retained; IAM suite passed.

development_failures.failure: An initial broad compilation encountered an unrelated concurrent recovery SnapshotStore field mismatch.
development_failures.resolution: Did not edit the other task; final bootstrap suite and full app/database builds passed in the current worktree.
